meta.note: Manual CSO pass — automated gstack/cso tool not available in this agent environment. Findings derived from static analysis of all source files.

findings.title: GitHub PAT embedded in git remote URL
findings.description: git remote get-url origin returns a URL with an embedded GitHub Personal Access Token. Token lives in .git/config of all worktrees. Not in tracked source but accessible to any process that reads git config.
findings.remediation: Rotate PAT immediately. Re-set remote using SSH or credential-manager HTTPS.

findings.title: Vendor secrets in git history (pre-rotation)
findings.description: Commits before 8d6c2ab contain backend/.env.bak with real Groq, OpenAI, and Clerk secret keys. Keys were rotated by CHRA-858, rendering the historical values inert.
findings.remediation: BFG/git-filter-repo to remove old blobs, then force-push with team coordination. Or document as intentional-inert in SECURITY.md.

findings.title: Expired authToken persists in chrome.storage.local across sessions
findings.description: authToken is stored locally and loaded on content script init. Clerk JWTs expire (~1h). On shared workstations the stale token persists until OS-side TTL. No signedOut hook clears storage.
findings.remediation: Hook Clerk signedOut/session-expired event to call chrome.storage.local.remove(['authToken', 'refreshToken']).

findings.title: Dual auth-token storage creates stale-token race between popup and service worker
findings.description: api-client.js loads authToken from storage async on init; SW reads from Clerk SDK and falls back to storage. Popup-driven JWT rotation may not update storage, causing SW to send stale tokens.
findings.remediation: Single source of truth: SW owns token fetch; popup always delegates to SW for auth operations.

findings.title: Cookie / Set-Cookie headers not stripped in _handleFetch proxy
findings.description: The SW's TOCAFICHADR_FETCH proxy strips Authorization (correct) but does not strip cookie or set-cookie headers. A malicious content script could inject session cookies targeting a proxied path.
findings.remediation: Extend header strip set to include 'cookie' and 'set-cookie'.

findings.title: 2.5 MB bundles include react-native and viem as transitive Clerk deps
findings.description: esbuild bundles are 2.5 MB each; npm cleanup output shows react-native and viem in the dep tree. These packages have no extension runtime use case and increase supply-chain surface.
findings.remediation: Audit Clerk dep tree; evaluate tree-shaking or lighter Clerk integration. Consider --external flags for unused large submodules.

findings.title: canvas@3.2.3 native runtime dependency — should be devDependency
findings.description: canvas is in 'dependencies' but only used by scripts/generate-icons.mjs (one-off dev script). Native addon adds build friction and an unnecessary attack surface in production.

findings.title: TRUSTED_SENDER_URL_PREFIXES hardcodes a single G-Hosp hostname
findings.description: The SW allowlist hardcodes 'https://prbentogoncalves.g-hosp.com.br/'. If the hospital changes URLs or adds subdomains, users at the new URL are blocked without an extension update.
findings.remediation: Derive trusted origins from manifest host_permissions or a configurable emrBaseUrl setting.

findings.title: _swDebugLog has no rate limit — can flood /api/debug-log in error loops
findings.description: In repeated failure scenarios (e.g., auth loops), _swDebugLog posts diagnostics on every message. No debounce, count cap, or circuit breaker.
findings.remediation: Add in-memory rate limiter: max N posts per 60s window.

findings.title: 150ms setTimeout race in offscreen document startup
findings.description: service-worker.src.js:521-523 uses a fixed 150ms delay after creating the offscreen document before forwarding OFFSCREEN_START. On slow hardware this arrives before the listener is registered and is silently dropped.
findings.remediation: Await offscreenReadyResolver promise instead of sleeping.

findings.title: CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY hardcoded in SW — intentional
findings.description: pk_live_... is the Clerk publishable key, designed for client-side embedding. Not a secret. Correct usage.

findings.title: TOCAFICHADR_AUTH_REQUIRED now enabled in production
findings.description: Commit 8d6c2ab enables server-side auth enforcement. All extension API routes now require valid Clerk JWT. Previously flagged as missing.

findings.title: SW message router correctly implements sender allowlisting
findings.description: _isTrustedSender and _isTelemetrySender correctly gate all onMessage handlers. Telemetry-only origins (Clerk hosted UI) may only send TOCAFICHADR_DEBUG_LOG. All others get Untrusted sender error.

findings.title: TOCAFICHADR_FETCH proxy correctly validates URL origin and path
findings.description: parsedTarget.origin !== parsedBase.origin check prevents SSRF. /api/ path prefix requirement limits proxy to extension API. Authorization header stripped from inbound and re-added from Clerk token.

bundle_stats.note: Both bundles are 2.5 MB each — unusually large for a Chrome extension. Traced to @clerk/chrome-extension pulling react-native and viem as transitive deps. Chrome Web Store hard limit is 4 MB per extension package (sum of all files). This is within limit but leaves little headroom.
